exposure: transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) combined with dual-access thrombolysis
cohort: The study included 25 patients with acute severe non-cirrhotic porto-mesenteric vein thrombosis (NC-PMVT) treated from January 2018 to February 2023.
finding: The combination of TIPS and dual-access thrombolysis appears to be safe and effective for patients with acute severe NC-PMVT.
